replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
Both sides' material claims are accepted, and they converge on the same answer. The record is clean and the money goes back to the rider.

To the driver: your own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00201, weight 1.0, COMPLETE — 98 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps) never brings you closer than 779.93 m to the pickup pin at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive. Your concession that limbs (b) and (c) of POL-NS-01 fail is correct and is accepted: there are zero qualifying in-geofence fixes at the STANDARD 50 m radius, and a longest in-geofence run of 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum dwell. Limbs (a) and (d) being met — an 'arrived' event and a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination — carries no weight once limb (b) fails, because POL-NS-01 is conjunctive. The fee is therefore not chargeable under the anchor clause.

Still to the driver: no rescue is available under POL-NS-03. That clause only helps a driver who held position outside the 50 m radius but within 400 m of the pin; you were never within 780 m, so this is not a wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case and no 50% goodwill payment arises. And no driver compensation is payable under POL-NS-07: it operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. The anti-farming guard does not trip in any event — 3 no-show terminations in 30 days across 96 completed trips is 3.1%, under both the absolute and rate limbs — so nothing there changes the outcome.

To the rider: POL-NS-02 gives you a full refund — no qualifying in-radius fix existed in the 15 minutes before the 08:09:40 cancellation. POL-NS-06 gives the same result independently: measured in-geofence dwell of 0 seconds against a 300-second minimum, a 300-second shortfall, and the accumulation limb (i) is unavailable because the traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00201-01) is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and there are no in-geofence intervals to sum in any case. POL-NS-04 also exonerates you outright: your 08:05:33 message ('hello? i dont see any car at 118') is locating and coordinating, the driver never replied and placed no in-app call, and your device stayed within 24.9 m of the pin across all 122 qualifying fixes, well inside the STANDARD 100 m presence radius.

The 'arrived' marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05: it was tapped at 08:02:14 while the driver was at least 779.93 m away, far beyond the 300 m threshold. The waiting clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is none anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies — full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival record against the driver. On the apparent conflict between the trip record's arrival marker and the trace: POL-NS-05 exists precisely to resolve a marker placed while the driver was elsewhere, so this is not the unresolved contradiction that would escalate.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The trace has 100% coverage and no gaps, the two chat messages reconcile with trip_record.chat_message_count, and the $4.00 fee reconciles with the STANDARD zone fee and the RYDE_X tier — so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d). Neither party's counterparty dispute counter is elevated, the anti-farming check is clear, and the deciding fact is carried by the driver's own trace at weight 1.0, well clear of the 0.70 floor.

Outcome: the $4.00 cancellation-fee line on EV-FARE-00201 is refunded in full to the rider; payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0 is reversed to that extent and nothing further (no booking or platform fee on a completed trip is in issue); no driver compensation; and trip TRP-00201 is referred for recording as a false-arrival event against DRV-01590.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record trip TRP-00201 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-01590 — the 'arrived' marker was placed at 2026-07-23T08:02:14+08:00 while the driver's own trace placed him 779.93 m from the pickup pin, beyond the 300 m false-arrival threshold, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.
